headline: Miscreants set passenger bus on fire in Baridhara
summary: A Baishakhi Paribahan bus on the Savar-Notun Bazar route was targeted in the capital's Baridhara area; no casualties reported.
details: A passenger bus belonging to Baishakhi Paribahan was set on fire by miscreants in the Baridhara area of the capital on Friday evening.
The incident occurred around 5:45 PM in the 'J' block area of Baridhara. The bus, which operates on the Savar-Notun Bazar route, had just dropped off passengers when the attack happened.
Two to three miscreants reportedly set the fire and fled the scene immediately. Passengers managed to exit the vehicle safely before the flames spread, preventing any casualties.
Two units from the Baridhara Fire Station were called to the scene and successfully extinguished the blaze.

Police from the Vatara police station are investigating the case. They are analyzing CCTV footage from the surrounding area to identify the suspects, as clear footage from the immediate vicinity was not available.
Officer-in-Charge of Vatara Police Station, Mohammad Mazharul Islam, stated that the driver and assistant driver have been taken to the station for questioning.

headline_marked: 1,535 hospitalised as [[3 more die of dengue]] in 24 hours
headline: 1,535 hospitalised as 3 more die of dengue in 24 hours
summary: The DGHS reports a surge in hospitalisations and deaths, with the total death toll now reaching 455.
details: At least three dengue patients died and 1,535 others were hospitalised in the 24 hours leading up to 8:00 am today, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
Of the reported deaths, two occurred in the Dhaka division and one in the Khulna division.
These latest fatalities bring the cumulative death toll to 455, while the total number of cases has reached 145,906.
Currently, 5,773 dengue patients are undergoing treatment in hospitals across the country.
